maddeler.e:
أضطجع (form VIII)
# أَضْطَجِعُ (ʔaḍṭajiʕu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
# أَضْطَجِعَ (ʔaḍṭajiʕa) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
# أَضْطَجِعْ (ʔaḍṭajiʕ) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.d͡ʒiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَجَعَ (iḍṭajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
